name: R030-skarmory-toxic-curse-ai-replacement
why: Challenge 5. The player's Skarmory (578: Toxic, Curse, Rest, Fly) badly poisons the opponent's lead Dugtrio (564: fast, frail, only Double-Edge touches a Steel/Flying mon) and then uses Curse every turn, so Curse is the last move of every turn (Skarmory is slower). Skarmory is Steel/Flying and survives Dugtrio's resisted hits. When Dugtrio faints from the poison at turn end, the AI scores its replacements with the last move still Curse (battle_ai_switch_items.c:775-779): Dewgong (584) and Miltank (603) have no Fire/Electric move, so neither is super-effective against Skarmory, the type pass finds nothing and the damage pass runs with Curse as the current move, which gives 0 damage (damageCalc.ts TYPE_MYSTERY).
